title: Payment Terms Schedule for Security Deposits: Installments, Due Dates and Channels
content:
Each Security Deposits tier sets whether its deposit may be paid in installments, how many, the share of the first installment, the days allowed before the deposit or first installment is due, whether it must be paid before the meter is energized, and what follows when an installment goes unpaid.

## Schedule

| Tier | Installments allowed | Installments granted | First installment (percent of the required amount) | Days from the assessed date to the due date | Paid before the meter is energized | Unpaid installment accelerates the remainder |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential Standard Deposit | yes | 3 | 50 | 20 | no | yes |
| Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit | yes | 3 | 50 | 10 | no | yes |
| Seasonal Residence Deposit | no | 1 | 100 | 20 | yes | yes |
| Farm Service Deposit | yes | 3 | 50 | 20 | no | yes |
| General Service Deposit | no | 1 | 100 | 10 | yes | yes |
| Irrigation and Large Power Deposit | no | 1 | 100 | 10 | yes | yes |

An installment count of 1 means the deposit is due in full. The first installment is the stated percent of the required amount, rounded to the cent; the remainder is split evenly over the remaining installments, the last one absorbing any cent difference. The due-date days are calendar days counted from the assessed date and govern the full deposit or the first installment; later installments fall due with the next monthly bills.

## Payment channels

On every tier a deposit may be paid through these channels and no others: online by card, online by e-check, by card through the phone IVR, in cash at a district office, by check at a district office, by mailed check, by money order, and at a payment kiosk.

## Points of reading

- On the three tiers with a single installment, the first installment percent is 100, which is the whole required amount.
- Hypothetical illustration: a Farm Service Deposit of $305.00 granted three installments has a first installment of $152.50; the remaining $152.50 is split into $76.25 and $76.25.
- Hypothetical illustration: a Residential Standard Deposit of $215.00 granted three installments has a first installment of $107.50; the remaining $107.50 splits into $53.75 and a last installment of $53.75.
